title: A Transformer-Based Risk Prediction Model for Contrast Media Extravasation During High-Pressure Injection: A Dual-Center Study with External Validation.
summary: A Transformer model predicted contrast-media extravasation during high-pressure CT injection, with cross-validation and a separate-center external validation.
